summary: Re-tested FORSIDES News Studio after async-job refactor. Backend: 11/11 pytest tests PASSED via public URL (job flows for search~112s, analyze-topic~40s, analyze-url~35s, compose~10s; direct caption/quality/visual-image). Frontend: Mode 3 (/compose) end-to-end works — text → live canvas → 'Optimiser le visuel avec l'IA' job succeeded (~30s) → title reformulated ('Solvabilité II : l'EIOPA relève l'exigence de capital des assureurs vie à 8,5%'), format A/B toggle works, data view populates key_figure_value/important_date, download buttons present. Mode 2 (/research) end-to-end works — search job returned 6 topic cards in ~129s, topic-generate-0 → analyze-topic job → /studio populated (score-panel 92/100, all subscores, caption-textarea, visual-canvas with FORSIDES NEWS template, all action buttons). Mode 1 (/analyze-url) verified via backend job test (EIOPA URL). Async job + polling pattern fully resolves the previous 60s Cloudflare timeouts. Ready for release.

minor.issue: Job takes ~110-130s to complete (well under polling window). No functional issue, but consider caching Google News RSS results or parallelizing the LLM scoring stage to reduce latency.
Many French institutional sites still 403 the scraper; jina.ai fallback helps but occasional error results. Job returns friendly error, as designed.

ui_bugs.issue: In Mode 3 Data view (format 'B'), the 'Date de publication : 15 janvier 2026' text visibly overlaps the FORSIDES logo circle in the bottom-right of the canvas. Consider constraining the text box width or moving the logo/date placement.

The banner shows 'SEPTEMBRE 2026' rather than the important_date month (e.g. JANVIER 2026 for a Jan 15 2026 date). Verify this label derives from meta.date/important_date, not a hard-coded/current-month fallback.

action_items: (Optional) Fix banner month/year label in VisualPreview to reflect important_date instead of a static/current month.
(Optional) Prevent text/logo overlap in Data-view visual (bottom-right corner).
critical_code_review_comments: Async job + polling pattern is a solid fix for the Cloudflare 60s edge timeout; job state persisted in MongoDB with clean status/result/detail fields.
server.py length is fine, but do_search sends 14 candidates to Claude; a two-stage (Haiku dedup → Sonnet score top-6) split would cut latency further.
runJob polling helper in lib/api.js uses 3s interval and 240s cap — matches backend timings well.
Frontend correctly wires all Mode 1/2/3 flows through the job pattern; no direct legacy calls remain.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Async job pattern verified end-to-end. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_forsides_api.py uses run_job() helper and covers /api/jobs/{search,analyze-topic,analyze-url,compose} + direct /api/caption /api/quality /api/visual-image. Full pytest run takes ~6.5 minutes because search+analyze-topic dominate. Frontend Playwright: Mode 3 is the fastest (~30s job). Mode 2 topic listing takes ~130s so budget 180s polling. Studio testids confirmed: score-panel, score-total, caption-textarea, visual-canvas, caption-regenerate/shorten/quality, visual-download, visual-format-A/B. Only cosmetic issues remain (banner month, Data-view text/logo overlap).
rca of the issue: N/A — previous 60s Cloudflare edge-timeout issue is fully resolved by the async job + polling architecture (search job completes ~112s and is polled by the browser, not held open in a single HTTP request).
